mapper.select: SELECT p.payment_id, p.amount, p.token, p.created_at, p.payment_method, s.status, pl.name, DATEDIFF(s.end_date, CURDATE()) AS daysDiff FROM payment p LEFT JOIN subscription s ON p.subs_id = s.subs_id LEFT JOIN plan pl ON pl.plan_id = p.plan_id WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY p.payment_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (amount, token, payment_method, status, plan_id, member_id, subs_id) VALUES (#{amount}, #{token}, #{paymentMethod}, #{status}, #{planId}, #{memberId}, #{subsId})
INSERT INTO payment (amount, token, payment_method, status, member_id) VALUES (#{amount}, #{token}, #{paymentMethod}, #{status}, #{memberId})
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status = 'REFUNDED' WHERE token = #{token}
